name: Athridas Bearmantle
summary: In Dolanaar, Athridas Bearmantle works to protect the settlement and its wilds. The night elf druid sends young adventurers to investigate corruption among local wildlife and the nearby Gnarlpine furbolgs.

sections.title: Guardian of Dolanaar
sections.body: In Dolanaar, Athridas Bearmantle helps defend night elves arriving from Shadowglen. Teldrassil, the newly grown world tree, shows unnatural signs of decay and unrest. Athridas organizes local scouting and guards the township against threats from the surrounding wilds.

sections.title: The Furbolg Affliction
sections.body: Athridas worries over the nearby Gnarlpine furbolgs. Once peaceful neighbors, the tribe has fallen to spreading madness and corruption that poisons its shamans and chieftains, driving them to violence against the Kaldorei. Athridas calls on willing champions to contain the danger and investigate the deeper taint taking root in the wilderness.

faq.answer: Athridas Bearmantle is a night elf in Dolanaar on Teldrassil. He organizes the settlement's defense and calls on adventurers to confront threats moving through the World Tree's boughs.

faq.q: Where can I find Athridas Bearmantle?
faq.answer: Find Athridas in Dolanaar, the first major town night elf adventurers reach after leaving Shadowglen in Teldrassil.

faq.q: What threats does Athridas focus on?
faq.answer: Athridas focuses on the aggressive Gnarlpine furbolgs, whose corruption has driven them to attack. He directs travelers to quell their assaults, investigate their madness, and recover vital relics.

faq.q: Why are the Gnarlpine furbolgs attacking Dolanaar?
faq.answer: The Gnarlpine tribe has fallen to an unnatural corruption spreading through Teldrassil. It has driven their shamans and warriors mad with hostility toward the night elves.

faq.q: What role does Athridas play in securing Teldrassil?
faq.answer: Athridas organizes an early defense against corruption among Teldrassil's beasts and furbolgs, working to keep the danger from overrunning Dolanaar.

angles.text: For young Kaldorei leaving Shadowglen, Athridas shows the struggles of their new home, already threatened from within.
Athridas's efforts against the corrupted Gnarlpine and his concern for ancient relics touch on the balance of nature druids are sworn to restore.
